meta.title: Our story — Mundaka Surf Academy
meta.description: The story of Mundaka Surf Academy, a surf school in Mundaka, Bizkaia.

about.title: Our story
about.p1: Mundaka Surf Academy is a surf school in Mundaka, a fishing village at the mouth of the Urdaibai estuary, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
about.p2: One of the best-known left-hand waves in the world breaks here, but there are also calm corners to take your first steps. That is why lessons move between different spots depending on each group's level.
about.p3: We teach beginners, surfers who want to improve and riders working on technique, always reading the sea, the tide and the wind of the day.
about.note: Provisional text: the academy will send the final story.
about.photoAlt: The Santa Catalina hermitage on the rocks of Mundaka
about.lead: A surf school at one of Europe’s most famous waves, right inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve.

wave.title: The Mundaka left
wave.p1: When a Bay of Biscay swell meets the right tide, the mouth of the estuary forms a long, hollow left-hander over its sandbanks.
wave.p2: Big days are for expert surfers. To learn we look for the calmer corners of the estuary and the nearby beaches, depending on the tide and each group’s level.
wave.f1: A sand-bottom left at the mouth of the estuary
wave.f2: Conditions change with the tide, the wind and the swell
wave.f3: Every lesson moves to the safest spot for your level
wave.altB: A surfer inside a blue barrel in Mundaka
wave.altC: A surfer on a green wall

find.title: Mundaka, on the Basque coast

urdaibai.title: Surfing in a Biosphere Reserve
urdaibai.p1: Mundaka lies inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve, declared by UNESCO in 1984: marshes, beaches, woods and cliffs around the Gernika estuary.
urdaibai.p2: We look after it in every lesson: we respect the beaches, the wildlife and the people of the village, and we teach how to share the water.
urdaibai.alt: The San Juan de Gaztelugatxe hermitage on its islet

faq.a4: Towel, flip-flops and swimsuit. The surfboard and wetsuit are included and we hand them to you clean and dry.
faq.q5: How do I get to Mundaka and where do I park?
faq.a5: We recommend public transport: the train to Mundaka and the bus. Parking in the village is limited in summer.

controller.text: The controller of the data on this website is the owner of Mundaka Surf Academy:

data.title: What we collect
data.text: Only what you write in the booking and contact forms: your name, email, phone (optional), the lesson, date, people and level you choose and your message. This website uses no analytics or advertising tools.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To manage and confirm your booking, take the deposit through the payment provider and answer your messages.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.text: Performing the booking you request and your consent when sending the form (GDPR article 6.1.a and b).

retention.title: How long we keep it

recipients.title: Who receives it
recipients.text: Your data is never sold or used for advertising. On the academy's behalf it may be processed by the service that delivers the website's emails and by the payment provider (Stripe).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, object to or restrict its processing, and receive a copy (portability) by writing to the contact email. You can also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
